    EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_spanning_weights_for_perpendicular

    Spanning projective classes from a presilting complex and its perpendicular simples #

    Proves the lower rank inequality n ≤ r + |sim J(P)| of Lemma 2.2 (lem:perpendicular) over any field by showing that K₀(proj R) is spanned by the classes of the r basic summands of P together with at most one class per simple object of J(P) (exists_spanning_weights_for_perpendicular).

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_spanning_weights_for_perpendicular (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) {l : List (HomotopyCategory (FGModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))} (hl : P.BasicDecomposition l) :
    ∃ (w : Fin l.length ⊕ ↑(stableClasses (eulerWeight k P)) → ProjectiveClass R), ∀ (G : FiniteProjective R), ProjectiveClass.of G ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range w)

    All ambient projective classes lie in the span of the classes of basic summands and at most one additional class per stable simple.
